title: DR12_Response_200_Data_ShippingTo_Address

city.description: The city of the shipping destination address.

civility.description: The civility or title of the recipient (e.g., Mr., Mrs., Dr.).

company.description: The company or organization name of the shipping destination.

company2.description: The secondary company or organization name of the shipping destination (e.g., department or subsidiary).

country_iso_code.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the shipping destination address.

firstname.description: The first name of the recipient.

lastname.description: The last name of the recipient.

phone.description: The primary phone number of the recipient.

phone_secondary.description: The secondary phone number of the recipient.

state.description: The state, province, or region of the shipping destination address.

street1.description: The primary line of the shipping destination street address (e.g., street number and name).

street2.description: The secondary line of the shipping destination street address (e.g., building, floor, or suite number).

zip_code.description: The postal or zip code of the shipping destination address.

description: Recipient contact and postal address information for delivery.
